reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) discusses the impact of oxygen/nitrogen interstitials on phase segregation and softening in a different alloy system (TiVNbTa RHEA) during aging, and mentions strengthening from interstitial additions in other HEAs. It does not provide any support for the key premises regarding resonant acoustic mixing, uniform oxide coating, or the proposed mechanisms of grain refinement and thermal stress moderation during LPBF of AlCrFeNiSi.
premises: Nanoscale oxide dispersoids can be uniformly coated onto AlCrFeNiSi powder via resonant acoustic mixing
A uniform nano-oxide coating on powder surfaces will act as a grain refiner and thermal stress moderator during LPBF
The oxide dispersoids will reduce local thermal gradients and interrupt rapid grain growth
The oxide dispersoids will pin dislocations and grain boundaries in the solidified material
This dual action will minimize residual stresses and improve strength and ductility
